# Lazy Dictionary

> Lazy Dictionary converts English words into simplified phonetic spelling —
> the way they actually sound.

## What is the Lazy Alphabet?

The Lazy Alphabet is a simplified writing system for English. It removes
redundant letters (C, Q, X) and uses consistent letter-to-phoneme mappings
so every word is spelled exactly as it sounds.

Lazy Alphabet letters: A B D E F G H I J K L M N O P R S SH T TH U V W Y Z CH NG ZH

## Key Spelling Rules

- ph → f  (phone → fon)
- ck → k  (back → bak)
- c before e/i/y → s  (city → siti)
- c elsewhere → k  (cat → kat)
- qu → kw  (queen → kween)
- x → ks  (fox → foks)
- silent gh → drop  (night → nyt)
- kn → n  (knife → nyf)
- wr → r  (write → ryt)
- wh → w  (where → wer)
- tion → shon  (nation → nashon)
- ough → oo/uf/ot  (through → throo)
- double letters → single  (butter → buter)

## Interactive tool

Look up any English word at https://lazydictionary.com/ to see its Lazy spelling.
